subject.title: fix(sessions): use account names for direct display

question: Should `sessions.list` display the configured channel account name for an otherwise opaque direct-peer row across all supported channel configuration shapes?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proof-backed, but choosing account identity over a peer identifier is a user-visible cross-channel display-precedence policy rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Accept account-name fallback
options.body: Confirm that configured account names are the intended last-resort direct-session identity and land after current-head validation.

options.title: Keep opaque peer fallback
options.body: Reject this display-precedence change and retain the existing peer-id fallback until channel-specific display metadata is available.

recommendation.title: Accept account-name fallback
recommendation.body: Confirm that configured account names are the intended last-resort direct-session identity and land after current-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related Feishu DM/session-label work provides the closest available domain history for this precedence decision.
